# This CD analysis is EXPLORATORY

## load packages and data

```{r message=F}
rm(list = ls())

library(lavaan) # v.0.6-21
library(here) # v.1.0.1
library(dplyr) # v.1.2.1

load(here("Analysis_data", "df_frontoparietal.Rda"))
df_frontoparietal <- rename(df_frontoparietal, "SI" = "–SI")

load(here("Analysis_data", "df_frontoparietal_rawfunc.Rda"))
df_frontoparietal_rawfunc <- rename(df_frontoparietal_rawfunc, "SI" = "–SI")

df <- df_frontoparietal %>%
  left_join(
    df_frontoparietal_rawfunc %>%
      select(
        Subject,
        DE_rawfunc = DE,
        SI_rawfunc = SI,
        PT_rawfunc = PT,
        RE_rawfunc = RE,
        C_rawfunc = C
      ),
    by = "Subject"
  )

# remove CD values as they are newly calculated in this script
df <- df[,-(2:9),drop=FALSE] 

df_CD_G04 <-
  read.csv(here("Analysis_data", "G04_CD_in_timewindows_4subs_removed.csv"), sep = ",")
df_CD_G05 <-
  read.csv(here("Analysis_data", "G05_CD_in_timewindows_4subs_removed.csv"), sep = ",")
df_CD_G02 <-
  read.csv(here("Analysis_data", "G02_CD_in_timewindows_4subs_removed.csv"), sep = ",")
df_CD_G01 <-
  read.csv(here("Analysis_data", "G01_CD_in_timewindows_4subs_removed.csv"), sep = ",")
df_CD_Y01 <-
  read.csv(here("Analysis_data", "Y01_CD_in_timewindows_4subs_removed.csv"), sep = ",")
df_CD_Y04 <-
  read.csv(here("Analysis_data", "Y04_CD_in_timewindows_4subs_removed.csv"), sep = ",")

vars <- c("LM_R", "LM_S", "OE_R", "OE_S",
  "E_CD_OE_R", "E_CD_OE_S", "E_CD_LM_R", "E_CD_LM_S",
  "L_CD_OE_R", "L_CD_OE_S", "L_CD_LM_R", "L_CD_LM_S"
)
CD_dfs_mid <- list(df_CD_G04,df_CD_G01)
CD_dfs_left <- list(df_CD_G02,df_CD_G05)
CD_dfs_right <- list(df_CD_Y01,df_CD_Y04)

df_CD_mid <- Reduce(
  `+`,
  lapply(CD_dfs_mid, function(df) df[, vars])
) / length(CD_dfs_mid)

names(df_CD_mid) <- paste0(names(df_CD_mid), "_mid")

df_CD_left <- Reduce(
  `+`,
  lapply(CD_dfs_left, function(df) df[, vars])
) / length(CD_dfs_left)

names(df_CD_left) <- paste0(names(df_CD_left), "_left")

df_CD_right <- Reduce(
  `+`,
  lapply(CD_dfs_right, function(df) df[, vars])
) / length(CD_dfs_right)

names(df_CD_right) <- paste0(names(df_CD_right), "_right")

df_CD_raw <- cbind(
  ERPset = df_CD_G04$ERPset,
  df_CD_mid, df_CD_right, df_CD_left
)

```


## clean data
```{r}
# CD values
df_CD = df_CD_raw[,c(1,6:13,18:25,30:37)]

initial_NA_count <- sum(is.na(df_CD))

for (x in 2:ncol(df_CD)) {
  sample_mean = mean(df_CD[,x], na.rm = TRUE)
  sample_SD = sd(df_CD[,x], na.rm = TRUE)
  df_CD[,x][df_CD[,x] >
                        sample_mean+3*sample_SD] <- NA
  df_CD[,x][df_CD[,x] <
                        sample_mean-3*sample_SD] <- NA

}

final_NA_count <- sum(is.na(df_CD))
num_NAs_generated_CD <- final_NA_count - initial_NA_count
percentage_Exclusion_CD <- num_NAs_generated_CD/(nrow(df_CD)*8)

df_CD[, 2:9] <- scale(df_CD[, 2:9])

```

## combine data

```{r}
df_CD$ERPset_new <- sub("switching_sub-", "", df_CD$ERPset)
df_CD$Subject <- as.numeric(sub("_bin_average", "", df_CD$ERPset_new))

df <- df_CD %>%
  select(Subject, E_CD_OE_R_mid, E_CD_OE_S_mid, E_CD_LM_R_mid, E_CD_LM_S_mid, 
         L_CD_OE_R_mid, L_CD_OE_S_mid, L_CD_LM_R_mid, L_CD_LM_S_mid, 
         E_CD_OE_R_left, E_CD_OE_S_left, E_CD_LM_R_left, E_CD_LM_S_left, 
         L_CD_OE_R_left, L_CD_OE_S_left, L_CD_LM_R_left, L_CD_LM_S_left, 
         E_CD_OE_R_right, E_CD_OE_S_right, E_CD_LM_R_right, E_CD_LM_S_right, 
         L_CD_OE_R_right, L_CD_OE_S_right, L_CD_LM_R_right, L_CD_LM_S_right) %>%
  full_join(df, by = "Subject"
  )

```


## CD and Intelligence

```{r}
CD_int_model <- '
# --- Time-window factors ---
  CD_earlier =~ NA*E_CD_OE_R_mid + E_CD_OE_R_left + E_CD_OE_R_right +
                E_CD_OE_S_mid + E_CD_OE_S_left + E_CD_OE_S_right +
                E_CD_LM_R_mid + E_CD_LM_R_left + E_CD_LM_R_right +
                E_CD_LM_S_mid + E_CD_LM_S_left + E_CD_LM_S_right
  CD_earlier ~~ 1*CD_earlier
  CD_later   =~ NA*L_CD_OE_R_mid + L_CD_OE_R_left + L_CD_OE_R_right +
                L_CD_OE_S_mid + L_CD_OE_S_left + L_CD_OE_S_right +
                L_CD_LM_R_mid + L_CD_LM_R_left + L_CD_LM_R_right +
                L_CD_LM_S_mid + L_CD_LM_S_left + L_CD_LM_S_right
  CD_later ~~ 1*CD_later

  # --- Midline spatial proximity residuals ---
  E_CD_OE_R_mid ~~ E_CD_OE_R_left + E_CD_OE_R_right
  E_CD_OE_S_mid ~~ E_CD_OE_S_left + E_CD_OE_S_right
  E_CD_LM_R_mid ~~ E_CD_LM_R_left + E_CD_LM_R_right
  E_CD_LM_S_mid ~~ E_CD_LM_S_left + E_CD_LM_S_right
  L_CD_OE_R_mid ~~ L_CD_OE_R_left + L_CD_OE_R_right
  L_CD_OE_S_mid ~~ L_CD_OE_S_left + L_CD_OE_S_right
  L_CD_LM_R_mid ~~ L_CD_LM_R_left + L_CD_LM_R_right
  L_CD_LM_S_mid ~~ L_CD_LM_S_left + L_CD_LM_S_right
  
  
  
  # Cognitive ability
  ## intelligence model
  int =~ NA*BIS + equal("int=~BIS")*APM
  int ~~ 1*int

  BIS =~ NA*PC_Mean + PS_Mean + C_Mean + M_Mean
  BIS ~~ 1*BIS

  APM =~ NA*PropCorrOdd + equal("APM=~PropCorrOdd")*PropCorrEven
  APM ~~ 1*APM
  
  ## structural model
  int ~ CD_later
  int ~ CD_earlier

'

fit_CD_int <- cfa(CD_int_model, data = df, std.lv = T, 
                      missing = "ML")

summary(fit_CD_int, fit.measures = T, standardized = TRUE)


zFit1 <- standardizedSolution(fit_CD_int)
regressions1 <- subset(zFit1, op == "~")
correlations1 <- subset(zFit1, op == "~~")

inspect(fit_CD_int, "r2")


```

## full model CD, SCFC coupling, intelligence
```{r}
full_model <- '
# CD
# --- Time-window factors ---
  CD_earlier =~ NA*E_CD_OE_R_mid + E_CD_OE_R_left + E_CD_OE_R_right +
                E_CD_OE_S_mid + E_CD_OE_S_left + E_CD_OE_S_right +
                E_CD_LM_R_mid + E_CD_LM_R_left + E_CD_LM_R_right +
                E_CD_LM_S_mid + E_CD_LM_S_left + E_CD_LM_S_right
  CD_earlier ~~ 1*CD_earlier
  CD_later   =~ NA*L_CD_OE_R_mid + L_CD_OE_R_left + L_CD_OE_R_right +
                L_CD_OE_S_mid + L_CD_OE_S_left + L_CD_OE_S_right +
                L_CD_LM_R_mid + L_CD_LM_R_left + L_CD_LM_R_right +
                L_CD_LM_S_mid + L_CD_LM_S_left + L_CD_LM_S_right
  CD_later ~~ 1*CD_later

  # --- Midline spatial proximity residuals ---
  E_CD_OE_R_mid ~~ E_CD_OE_R_left + E_CD_OE_R_right
  E_CD_OE_S_mid ~~ E_CD_OE_S_left + E_CD_OE_S_right
  E_CD_LM_R_mid ~~ E_CD_LM_R_left + E_CD_LM_R_right
  E_CD_LM_S_mid ~~ E_CD_LM_S_left + E_CD_LM_S_right
  L_CD_OE_R_mid ~~ L_CD_OE_R_left + L_CD_OE_R_right
  L_CD_OE_S_mid ~~ L_CD_OE_S_left + L_CD_OE_S_right
  L_CD_LM_R_mid ~~ L_CD_LM_R_left + L_CD_LM_R_right
  L_CD_LM_S_mid ~~ L_CD_LM_S_left + L_CD_LM_S_right
  
  # SCFC coupling
  coupling =~ NA*SI_rawfunc + PT_rawfunc + RE_rawfunc + C_rawfunc + DE_rawfunc
  coupling ~~ 1*coupling
  RE_rawfunc ~~ DE_rawfunc
  PT_rawfunc ~~ DE_rawfunc
  C_rawfunc ~~ 0*C_rawfunc
  
  
  # Cognitive ability
  ## intelligence model
  int =~ NA*BIS + equal("int=~BIS")*APM
  int ~~ 1*int

  BIS =~ NA*PC_Mean + PS_Mean + C_Mean + M_Mean
  BIS ~~ 1*BIS

  APM =~ NA*PropCorrOdd + equal("APM=~PropCorrOdd")*PropCorrEven
  APM ~~ 1*APM
  
  ## structural model
  int ~ coupling
  int ~ CD_later
  int ~ CD_earlier
  coupling ~~ CD_later
  coupling ~~ CD_earlier

'

fit_full <- cfa(full_model, data = df, std.lv = T, 
                      missing = "ML")

summary(fit_full, fit.measures = T, standardized = TRUE)

zFit2 <- standardizedSolution(fit_full)
regressions2 <- subset(zFit2, op == "~")
correlations2 <- subset(zFit2, op == "~~")

inspect(fit_full, "r2")

```
